businessIdentity.vision: To provide reliable, high‑quality electrical, solar, and air conditioning services with a family‑centric approach, ensuring customer satisfaction and long‑term value.
businessIdentity.description:
Raw Power and Lighting operates as a full‑service electrical contractor delivering B2B and B2C solutions across South East Queensland. The company’s portfolio encompasses comprehensive electrical installations and maintenance for residential and commercial properties, solar‑plus‑battery storage systems, and air‑conditioning supply, installation, and servicing. By integrating these three core disciplines—electrical, renewable energy, and climate control—Raw Power and Lighting offers a single‑team solution that streamlines project delivery, reduces coordination overhead, and ensures consistent quality across all trades. The firm also provides specialised maintenance contracts for property managers, strata bodies, and commercial clients, combining preventative inspections with rapid reactive response to minimise downtime during emergencies such as floods.

Founded as an Australian‑owned family business, Raw Power and Lighting has built its reputation on a commitment to reliability, transparent pricing, and local expertise. While the precise founding date is not disclosed, the company’s branding emphasizes its status as a trusted, locally‑owned electrician serving the Gold Coast, Brisbane, Toowoomba, and the broader South East Queensland region. Its market positioning hinges on being the go‑to provider for property owners who value punctual service, clear communication, and honest, upsell‑free quotations. The firm differentiates itself through a combination of fast, reliable service, free quotes, and a licensed, affiliated workforce that uses proven brands such as Tesla Powerwall for battery storage and industry‑leading climate‑control equipment.

In a competitive landscape of electrical contractors, Raw Power and Lighting leverages its one‑stop‑shop model and deep familiarity with coastal environmental conditions to stand out. The company’s value proposition is anchored in quality‑first installations, custom‑designed solar solutions that maximise energy production, and tailored air‑conditioning sizing that optimises efficiency and operating costs. By offering comprehensive preventative inspections, transparent reporting, and dedicated support for property managers and commercial clients, Raw Power and Lighting positions itself as a reliable partner that not only meets regulatory safety standards but also delivers long‑term cost savings and operational resilience for its customers.

services.name: Solar Systems & Battery Storage
services.description: We design, install, and maintain solar power systems with battery storage solutions, helping clients reduce energy costs and increase resilience. Our approach focuses on long-term performance and cost-effectiveness.
services.aiLaymanSummary:
Solar Systems & Battery Storage is a complete package that turns sunlight into clean, reliable electricity for homes, businesses, and even whole communities. We handle everything from the first energy audit to the final connection to the grid, and we add batteries so you can store power for cloudy days, nights, or power outages.

The process is straightforward:  
1. We start with an energy audit to see how much sun you get and how much power you need.  
2. Then we design a custom system, picking the best panels, inverters, and batteries.  
3. We install the equipment on roofs or ground, hook it up to the grid, and get it running.  
4. Finally, we set up monitoring tools and offer routine maintenance so the system keeps working at peak performance.

What you gain:  
- **Lower electricity bills** – you use the free energy from the sun instead of buying power from the grid.  
- **Energy independence** – batteries let you keep power even when the grid goes down.  
- **Long‑term savings** – our systems are built for durability, so you get a steady return on your investment for years.  
- **Sustainability** – you reduce your carbon footprint and support clean energy for the planet.

facts.text: Official Name: Raw Power and Lighting
Industry: Technology
Business Model: B2B services

Service Name: Electrical Services
Description: Licensed electrical upgrades, repairs, and new installations for residential, commercial and property‑management clients across the Gold Coast, Brisbane and Toowoomba.
Applications: Electrical system upgrades, Fault repairs, New construction wiring, Compliance inspections

Service Name: Solar & Battery Services
Description: Design, supply and installation of solar photovoltaic panels and battery storage systems, fully compliant with Australian standards and the REC Solar Professional network.
Applications: Residential solar power systems, Commercial solar installations, Battery backup solutions, Energy‑efficiency upgrades

Service Name: Air Conditioning Services
Description: Supply, installation, maintenance and repair of split‑system and ducted air‑conditioning units for homes and businesses.
Applications: New AC installations, System upgrades, Routine servicing, Fault diagnosis and repair

Service Name: Maintenance Support
Description: Preventative maintenance programmes for electrical, solar, battery and air‑conditioning assets to ensure reliability and extend service life.
Applications: Scheduled inspections, Routine servicing, System health reporting, Early fault detection

Service Name: Project Services
Description: End‑to‑end management of complex electrical and communications installation projects, from planning through to commissioning.
Applications: Large‑scale commercial fit‑outs, Multi‑unit residential developments, Specialised communications infrastructure

Service Name: Electrical Maintenance Support for Property Managers, Strata & Businesses
Description: Ongoing electrical maintenance support designed to keep commercial and residential sites safe, compliant and operating smoothly. Includes reactive fault response, preventative inspections, lighting and power repairs, and coordinated communication with tenants and stakeholders.
Applications: Property managers, Strata managers, Commercial building owners, Business facilities managers

Service Name: Solar & Battery Storage Solutions
Description: Custom‑designed solar photovoltaic systems and battery storage installations, upgrades, inverter services and performance monitoring. Solutions are tailored to the client’s energy usage and local Gold Coast conditions.
Applications: Homeowners seeking lower electricity bills, Families preparing for electric vehicle charging, Businesses aiming to reduce operating costs and increase energy independence

Service Name: Air Conditioning Supply, Installation & Maintenance
Description: Supply, install, replace, service and troubleshoot split‑system air‑conditioning units for residential and small commercial properties. Includes sizing advice and efficiency recommendations.
Applications: Homeowners, Office spaces, Retail stores, Small commercial properties on the Gold Coast

Service Name: Electrical Services (Residential & Commercial)
Description: Comprehensive electrical solutions for both residential and commercial properties, including wiring, lighting, panel upgrades, and safety inspections.
Applications: Homeowners, Landlords, Strata managers, Retail and hospitality venues, Small businesses, New construction, Renovations, Electrical fault diagnosis, Compliance and safety upgrades

Service Name: Air Conditioning (Supply, Install & Maintenance)
Description: We install and maintain air conditioning systems that suit your space, budget, and comfort goals—without upsells. From single-room split systems to larger commercial units, we handle the entire process from supply to ongoing maintenance.
Applications: Residential homes, Commercial offices, Retail spaces, Industrial facilities

Service Name: Solar Systems & Battery Storage
Description: We design, install, and maintain solar power systems with battery storage solutions, helping clients reduce energy costs and increase resilience. Our approach focuses on long-term performance and cost-effectiveness.
Applications: Residential rooftops, Commercial buildings, Industrial sites, Community solar projects

Service Name: Maintenance for Property Managers, Strata & Businesses
Description: Dedicated maintenance contracts for property managers, strata schemes, and businesses, ensuring clear communication and efficient job completion across multiple sites.
Applications: Multi-unit residential complexes, Commercial property portfolios, Strata-managed buildings

Process: Project Delivery Workflow
Description: A structured framework used to deliver complex electrical and communications projects on time and to a high standard.

Process: Installation Best‑Practice Method
Description: Standardised approach applied to all electrical, solar, battery and air‑conditioning installations to ensure quality and compliance.

Process: Preventative Maintenance Process
Description: Routine service programme designed to keep electrical, solar, battery and air‑conditioning systems operating efficiently.

Description: End-to-end workflow for installing and maintaining HVAC systems.

Description: Workflow for designing, installing, and commissioning solar PV and battery storage systems.
